title.value: Doubly Right Object Recognition: A Why Prompt for Visual Rationales
title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote: Doubly Right Object Recognition: A Why Prompt for Visual Rationales

extractions.description: The paper introduces a "doubly right" object recognition benchmark, requiring models to produce both correct labels and correct rationales for predictions. It proposes a "why prompt" to transfer rationales from language models into visual representations, improving model performance on doubly right object recognition and zero-shot transfer to unseen tasks and datasets.
